hints.title: Alternating Direction States
hints.text: Decompose the problem by tracking the last chosen value and whether the preceding transition stepped upwards or downwards.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Optimization
hints.text: To step up to value v, sum over all previous states with value u < v that stepped down. This corresponds to running prefix sums.

hints.title: Suffix Sum Optimization
hints.text: Similarly, to step down to value v, sum over all previous states with value u > v that stepped up via running suffix sums.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfZigzagArrays(self, n: int, m: int) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        if n == 1:
            return m % MOD
        # dp_up[v]: number of zigzag prefixes of length i ending with value v where last step was UP
        # dp_down[v]: number of zigzag prefixes of length i ending with value v where last step was DOWN
        # Base case length 2:
        dp_up = [0] * (m + 1)
        dp_down = [0] * (m + 1)
        for v in range(1, m + 1):
            dp_up[v] = v - 1 # previous element was smaller (1 .. v-1)
            dp_down[v] = m - v # previous element was larger (v+1 .. m)
            
        for _ in range(3, n + 1):
            next_up = [0] * (m + 1)
            next_down = [0] * (m + 1)
            # To step up to v, previous step had to be down to u < v
            # sum(dp_down[u] for u in 1..v-1)
            pref = 0
            for v in range(1, m + 1):
                next_up[v] = pref
                pref = (pref + dp_down[v]) % MOD
            # To step down to v, previous step had to be up to u > v
            # sum(dp_up[u] for u in v+1..m)
            suff = 0
            for v in range(m, 0, -1):
                next_down[v] = suff
                suff = (suff + dp_up[v]) % MOD
            dp_up, dp_down = next_up, next_down
            
        return (sum(dp_up) + sum(dp_down)) % MOD
```

complexity.notes: State transitions optimized with running prefix and suffix sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating transitions naively costs O(N * M^2), which times out for large bounds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D arrays of size M avoid allocating an N x M grid.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use running sums to eliminate the inner summation loop across values.
